summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for the Motion-Controlled Procedural Kids Game (3D WebGL / WebRTC) based on the master technical specification and user preferences. Covers WebRTC peer-to-peer signaling, mobile motion sensing and toddler-proof lockscreen, 3D procedural Sunny Countryside world, translating non-rotating overhead camera, local Web Audio synthesis, haptic feedback, 4 procedural vehicles (Convertible, Steam Train, Biplane, Digger), desktop parent calibration panel, and dynamic vehicle loader.
